releaseNotes:
- Alphabet Jump Rail Selection & Navigation: Seeking now only triggers upon pressing Select/Enter on a letter with active bubble preview; blur/left navigation smoothly restores grid focus without seeking; fixed cursor getting stuck on letters T-Z; clamped bottom at 'Z' and dismissed bubble when navigating to toolbar
- Top Toolbar Navigation Safety: Clamped upward navigation on all top buttons (Back, Categories, Sort, Refresh), preventing unintended focus escape into the grid content rows
- Arch Linux Auto-Updater Relaunch: Enhanced the Linux update script to reliably relaunch /usr/bin/plix upon completion using desktop session launchers (gtk-launch, gio) and systemd user scopes
- Memory & Performance Optimizations: Bounded image cache and pooled connections preventing low-memory crashes when rapidly scrolling large libraries
- App Version Bump: v1.8.5 (versionCode 47)
